ui.controls.touch_hold: Hold your finger down – look at an object; on an empty spot, open the Inventory
ui.controls.touch_hold_selected: Hold with an item selected – cancel the selection
ui.controls.touch_slide: A finger resting on the picture – the name of the place under it; lifting after a slide does nothing
ui.controls.touch_eye: The Eye button or two fingers on the picture – markers on every place you can tap
ui.controls.touch_double_tap: Double tap – skip walking (Adam is there at once)
ui.controls.touch_item: Items – tap one in the Inventory, then a place in the scene; hold your finger on an item to look at it
ui.controls.touch_line: Tap during a conversation – next subtitle
ui.controls.touch_back: Back button – skip a subtitle, close a panel or pause the game
ui.inventory.look_hint_touch: Hold your finger on the item to look at it.
ui.inventory.combine_hint_touch: Tap a second item to combine them, or close the Inventory and tap it on something in the scene.
